tasks.old_behavior: git log -L with --raw, --name-only, --name-status, or --summary dies with "-L does not yet support the requested diff format"
tasks.new_behavior: git log -L with --raw, --name-only, --name-status, or --summary succeeds and outputs metadata-only diff content (filepair fields: mode, oid, status, path)
tasks.compatibility_reason: The format allowlist for -L (line-level-traverse) is expanded from PATCH|NO_OUTPUT to also allow RAW, NAME, NAME_STATUS, and SUMMARY. This is an additive/relaxing change: previously erroring option combinations now produce output. No existing git commands or scripts that previously worked will break, but scripts that explicitly tested for the error (test_must_fail) would need updating. This is a documented feature addition per commit message.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run t4211-line-log.sh regression tests which cover all four newly allowed formats plus verify that --stat/--numstat/--shortstat/--dirstat remain blocked.

strategy.preferred_artifact: unit test, small linked program, or language-level test case
strategy.trigger_surface: call the public API with old/new contract boundary inputs and assert behavior
strategy.required_observation: acceptance, default, precedence, exit status, output, and resulting state

required_output.goal: produce one command or code artifact that reaches target_location.new_lines
must_include: exact command(s) or generated code path
expected reachability signal such as return code, log, output, coverage, breakpoint, or tracepoint
input values that exercise old/new compatibility behavior
contract_probe with before/after commands and the registered comparison oracle
required_output.do_not_execute: Generate artifacts and commands; do not run destructive or privileged tests unless the user explicitly asks.
